disclosure: WO-SWOF-W2-001's apply receipt was produced by the first, still-valid run of the apply process. That run revealed a real defect: `git commit -a` silently skips NEW (untracked) files, so the commit staged nothing and HEAD stayed at the baseline (recorded candidate 7e1f912d863b8c155eb9ae5ae9682b0e185450fc, diff_count 0). The apply process was corrected to stage the admitted paths explicitly and to assert that the staged set is non-empty and in scope, then re-run in --commit-only mode for WO-001 (the writer's files were already on disk from the same run).
consequence: the field naming differs from the later three receipts (delta vs workorder_delta); the candidate SHA, staged set, focused test result and containment verdict are all present and correct, so no evidence was lost and no claim depends on the missing alias
